# ai_dotfiles — onboarding

## 1. Goal

**What:** The single source of the owner's global AI-CLI setup on macOS: one rules file, per-CLI settings keys, shared MCP servers, 35 skills and a journal hook, applied to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi and Antigravity so every CLI behaves the same way in every project.

**How:** `config/ai-clis.json` says which CLIs are on and where each reads things. `ai-dotfiles install` runs five Python steps that link what is read-only (the rules file, every skill folder, two commands, Pi's extension) and merge what a CLI writes back (settings keys, hook entries; MCP servers through `<cli> mcp add`). Every write is validated first, backed up, atomic, and rolled back on failure. `ai-dotfiles check` compares the live state with the repo, CI runs the unittest suites and shellcheck on every push, and a weekly GitHub Action mirrors each CLI's docs and reports upstream skill changes in a pull request.

**This branch (`feat/daily-log`):** adds the `daily-log` skill. One command, `daily-log`, is the only writer of the journal at `~/Documents/Claude/Projects/daily-logger`. A hook in each CLI counts a session's file edits and, at Stop, asks the model once to record the work if nothing was logged. New: step 5 `scripts/install/hooks.py`, the skill folder, a `COMMANDS` table and Pi extension link in `skills.py`, optional `hooks` and `extensions` keys in `ai-clis.json`, a "Logging" rule in `global-agents.md`, two test files and a fixture.

## 2. System design

**Shape:** one monolith of scripts and config, with no frontend or API: a CLI (`ai-dotfiles`), a second command (`daily-log`), a Pi extension and two GitHub Actions workflows.

### Tech stack

| Layer | Technology | Version | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| Language | Python, standard library only | 3.11+; CI runs 3.12 | `scripts/install.sh:80`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:35` |
| Language | Bash | — | `scripts/*.sh`, `scripts/ai-dotfiles` |
| Language | TypeScript, one file, no build (Pi's extension) | — | `skills/daily-log/hooks/daily-log.ts` |
| Config | JSON for the desired state, Markdown for rules and skills | — | `config/`, `skills/` |
| Tests | unittest, against a temporary `HOME` | — | `scripts/tests/`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:38` |
| Lint | shellcheck (warning level); pyright paths | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `pyrightconfig.json` |
| CI | GitHub Actions: tests and lint on push; Monday docs sync | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| Targets | Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, Antigravity | — | `config/ai-clis.json` |

### Workflows

#### install — `ai-dotfiles install`

```text
desired state ──▶ installer ──▶ global files
                      ├──▶ hook files
                      └──mcp add──▶ MCP registry
```

- desired state (repo): which CLIs are on and where each reads things, incl. optional `hooks` and `extensions` paths; the rules file, settings keys, MCP servers, skills — `config/ai-clis.json:4`, `scripts/install/installer.py:27`
- installer (repo): `ai-dotfiles install` runs `install.sh`, which checks the registry then runs one step per source; `update` fast-forwards `main` first — `scripts/ai-dotfiles:32`, `scripts/install.sh:86`, `:94`, `:98`, `:101`, `:104`, `:107`
- global files (home): links to `global-agents.md`, each skill folder, `~/.local/bin/{ai-dotfiles,daily-log}` and Pi's extension; `cli-settings.json` keys merged into each settings file; every write validated, backed up, atomic, rolled back on failure — `scripts/install/instructions.py:130`, `scripts/install/skills.py:30`, `:35`, `scripts/install/settings.py:150`, `scripts/install/installer.py:136`
- hook files (home): one `PostToolUse` and one `Stop` entry merged into each CLI's own file, found again by the `daily_log.py` path in their command; Antigravity gets named entries; foreign hooks untouched — `scripts/install/hooks.py:29`, `:52`, `:77`, `:113`
- MCP registry (CLIs): `<cli> mcp add` for each missing server; Antigravity's `mcp_config.json` is merged instead; servers are never removed — `scripts/install/mcp.py:62`, `:99`, `:85`

#### daily-log nudge — an edit, then the end of a turn, in any CLI (this branch)

```text
edit ──▶ hook tool ──▶ session file ──▶ hook stop ──▶ nudge
                                                        └──▶ daily-log add ──▶ journal
```

- edit (CLIs): a file tool finishes; PostToolUse fires with the tool name; Pi's extension forwards `tool_result` — `scripts/install/hooks.py:30`, `skills/daily-log/hooks/daily-log.ts:32`
- hook tool (repo): `daily_log.py hook tool` counts the call if its tool is in that CLI's edit set — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:323`, `:44`
- session file (home): `edits`, `nudges`, `logged`, `pending` per session under `~/.local/state/ai-dotfiles/daily-log/`; pruned after 7 days — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:248`, `:272`
- hook stop (repo): at turn end, if edits exist, nothing logged, under 2 nudges, new edits since the last, and not its own continuation, it replies once with the nudge in the CLI's own shape — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:329`, `:303`
- nudge (CLIs): the model reads "record it with `daily-log add --done --session <id>`"; it logs or says nothing is finished — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:52`
- `daily-log add` (repo): merges a `- [X] label` entry and its lines into today's block, creating the day block or week file; `--session` marks the session logged — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:123`, `:191`, `:281`
- journal (outside): `<root>/<yyyy>/<Mon>/week-<i>`, grammar in `LOG-FORMAT.md`; the root must already exist — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:67`, `:193`

The hook never exits non-zero or prints anything but JSON (`daily_log.py:361`); the command line it runs ends in `|| true` (`scripts/install/hooks.py:43`).

#### check — `ai-dotfiles check`, or CI on every push

```text
push ──▶ CI job ──▶ unit tests, shellcheck
ai-dotfiles check ──▶ healthcheck ──▶ unit tests, shellcheck
                          ├──▶ dry-run install (expect 0 changes)
                          └──▶ MCP registry
```

- CI job (GitHub): checks out, runs shellcheck and the tests on Python 3.12 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `:35`, `:38`
- healthcheck (repo): what `ai-dotfiles check` runs — `scripts/ai-dotfiles:35`
- unit tests, shellcheck (repo): the same suites locally, plus a scan for machine paths — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:80`, `:72`
- dry-run install (home): `install.sh --dry-run` must report zero pending changes, hooks included — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:22`
- MCP registry (CLIs): `<cli> mcp list` must show every shared server; Antigravity's file is read — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:54`, `:45`

#### weekly sync — Monday cron in `sync-cli-docs.yml`

```text
cron ──▶ sync job ──▶ docs mirror ──▶ mirror files ──▶ upstream report ──▶ PR
                      ▲ pages                          ▲ pinned files
                      docs sites                       GitHub API
```

- cron (GitHub): Monday 01:00 UTC, or on demand — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:6`
- sync job (GitHub): runs the mirror, the catalog update, then the report — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:46`, `:47`, `:59`
- docs mirror (repo): one fetcher per source kind (`llms`, `docs-json`, `github`); a source below its page floor or with an error keeps the previous copy — `scripts/upstream/sync-upstream.py:373`, `:432`, `:505`
- docs sites (outside): the four CLIs' docs, Google's and Meta's style guides — `config/upstream-docs.json`
- mirror files (repo): `docs/upstream/<source>/` with `MIRROR-INDEX.*`, never edited by hand — `scripts/upstream/sync-upstream.py:407`
- upstream report (repo): reads the staged diff, `skills.lock` and `cli-settings.json`; fetches each pinned file at its commit and on the default branch; writes the PR body — `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py:159`, `:91`
- GitHub API (outside): pinned files and each collection's tree — `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py:91`, `:102`
- PR (GitHub): `upstream-sync` force-pushed, the PR opened or edited — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:67`, `:70`, `:72`

## 3. Conventions

- Files: Python modules and tests in snake_case, one `test_<script>.py` per script; shell scripts and config files in kebab-case; every skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md`.
- Code: direct imports, no injection; each step imports `installer.py` from its own folder; subprocesses run synchronously through `subprocess.run` (`scripts/install/mcp.py:99`). Steps follow one shape: plan `(path, before, after)` changes, `installer.show`, then `installer.apply` (`scripts/install/hooks.py:184`).
- Errors: shell scripts run under `set -euo pipefail` (`scripts/install.sh:24`); install steps raise `ValueError` naming the path and refuse to guess (`scripts/install/instructions.py:124`); writes are backed up, atomic, and rolled back on failure (`scripts/install/installer.py:136`). The hook is the opposite: swallow everything and stay silent so a session is never blocked (`skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:365`, `hooks/daily-log.ts:22`).
- Tests: load each script by path and run against a temporary `HOME`, never the real one (`scripts/tests/support.py:11`, `scripts/tests/test_entrypoints.py:17`); `test_daily_log.py` runs against `scripts/tests/fixtures/daily-log/week-4`.
- Git: conventional-commit subjects (`feat(skills): …`, `refactor: …`); earlier work squash-merged as PRs ending in `(#N)`, the latest feature branches merged locally with merge commits (`Merge branch 'feat/…'`). `main` is the only long-lived branch, plus `upstream-sync`, force-pushed by the weekly job. Feature branches are named `feat/<name>`.

## 4. Common tasks

- Test: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests`
- Lint: `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/ai-dotfiles`
- Preview an install: `bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run` (zero changes on a configured Mac)
- Check the live state: `bash scripts/healthcheck.sh`, or `ai-dotfiles check`
- Install, update, uninstall: `ai-dotfiles install`, `ai-dotfiles update`, `ai-dotfiles uninstall`
- One step: `python3 scripts/install/<step>.py --dry-run`, `--uninstall`, `--target <cli>`
- Log work: `daily-log add --done "<label>" "<line>"`; `daily-log show`, `daily-log path`

## 5. Where to look

| I want to… | Look at… |
|---|---|
| switch a CLI on or off, or change where it reads | `config/ai-clis.json` |
| change a global rule | `config/global-agents.md` |
| enforce or default a CLI setting | `config/cli-settings.json`, then `scripts/install/settings.py` |
| add an MCP server | `config/mcp-servers.json` |
| add or update a skill | `skills/<name>/`, `skills/skills.lock`, `skills/which-skill/SKILL.md` |
| change how a step writes files | `scripts/install/installer.py` |
| support a new CLI's hooks | `EVENTS` in `scripts/install/hooks.py`, `EDIT_TOOLS` and `proceed()` in `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py` |
| change the nudge rules or its text | `on_stop()` and `NUDGE` in `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py` |
| change the journal grammar | `skills/daily-log/LOG-FORMAT.md`, then `add_entry()` |
| change Pi's hook behavior | `skills/daily-log/hooks/daily-log.ts` |
| add or change a docs source | `config/upstream-docs.json`, `scripts/upstream/sync-upstream.py`, the `collect-docs` skill |
| change the weekly PR report | `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| see why a check fails | `scripts/healthcheck.sh` |
